items.title: Fake IPTV Apps Spread Massiv Android Malware Targeting Mobile Banking Users

items.title: Critical Authentication Bypass in better-auth API Keys Plugin Allows Unauthenticated Account Takeover
items.description: A critical authentication bypass vulnerability in the better-auth API keys plugin allows unauthenticated attackers to mint privileged API keys for arbitrary users.
